title: The Lady of the Lake: beaten
notes: After the party beats her in the fight. She yields and tells them where the sword is, but curses it: the pull flips fewer coins. Then she sinks into the lake for good: she never speaks again, and that enchanted lake loses its resting blessing.

n1.speaker: Lady of the Lake
n1.text: Go, then. Find your stone. But the hand that struck me will find it heavier than any stone in the world.
